name: Juvéderm Fillers
title: Juvederm Dermal Fillers in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Juvederm hyaluronic acid fillers in Tustin from Tariq A. Khan, MD. Restore cheek volume, plump lips and soften lines around the nose and mouth. Results last 1 to 2 years.
lede: With age, the thin layer of fat under the skin thins out, cheeks hollow and lines deepen. Juvéderm fillers replace that lost volume, and Dr. Khan chooses the right product for each area.
glance: Hyaluronic acid fillers for cheeks, lips and smile lines, lasting one to two years.

signs.heading: What it treats
signs.intro: Juvéderm is a family of fillers. Each one is designed for a specific area or depth.
items: Lines from the nose to the mouth
Moderate to severe wrinkles around the mouth

basics.heading: How fillers work
paras: Juvéderm is made from hyaluronic acid gel. Your skin makes hyaluronic acid naturally, where it holds moisture and adds volume.
Injected under the skin, the gel temporarily replaces lost volume, lifting cheeks, plumping lips and softening lines. Results last one to two years depending on the product used.

options.name: Cheeks
options.text: Lifts and restores volume to the mid-face.

options.name: Lips
options.text: Adds shape and fullness and softens vertical lip lines.

options.name: Smile lines
options.text: Softens the lines between the nose and mouth.

steps.heading: Your appointment
items: Dr. Khan assesses your face and recommends the right product.
Precise injections for a balanced, natural result.
A check to see how you look once any swelling settles.

faq: One to two years, depending on the Juvéderm product and the area treated.
The goal is to restore what time took away, not to change your face. Dr. Khan favors a natural result.
Can fillers be combined with Botox?
Yes. Botox treats expression lines and filler restores volume, so they work well together. See Botox.
